description: Read one address's on-chain facts at a single block height: whether it has deployed bytecode (a contract) and how many bytes, its native balance, its USDC balance, and how many transactions it has sent. The block number, the block's timestamp and the RPC endpoint that answered travel with the answer, so the buyer can re-read the same block and check every figure. Choose this when you need one address's facts at a checkable moment: whether it is a contract, its USDC and native balance, and its transaction count, with the block height and the RPC endpoint that answered. Do not choose this for token analytics, historical flows or a portfolio: it reads Base mainnet only, one address at a time, and only the USDC balance among tokens. Example requests: What does this wallet hold on Base? 0x40505Da32d7Ecbf67cFC7F2F7CBf7d33EaBe223E | Is this address a contract or a plain account, and what is its USDC balance? | Give me the on-chain profile of 0x833589fCD6eDb6E08f4c7C32D4f71b54bdA02913: is it a contract, and what does it hold?

accepted_price.description: The quoted amount, echoed exactly; checked against the quote.

authorized_by.description: Identifier of the human or agent authorizing this job.

buyer_token.description: The buyer_token returned with your first purchase. It opens the purchase history for that buyer, including earlier deliverables.

idempotency_key.description: Retry key; the same key returns the same job.

payment_signature.description: x402 payment payload; required for a priced capability (see submit_job).

quote_id.description: The quote_id from POST /v1/jobs; required when priced.
